about_the_game:
Welcome to a dystopian future where every connection can be your last.

In void future, you take on the role of a skilled hacker operating in a near-future cyberpunk world, where corporations hold more power than governments, and personal freedom is a distant memory. As part of a secret underground hacking collective, you infiltrate corporate systems, steal sensitive data, and uncover dark secrets that could change the course of history.

GAMEPLAY

Engage in intense, tactical hacking missions where every line of code counts. Use your skills to breach firewalls, decrypt encrypted data, and infiltrate heavily-secured corporate networks. But be careful, every action you take leaves a digital footprint, and the more you push, the more you attract attention from powerful forces.

  • Hack & Explore: Navigate through complex systems, bypassing security protocols, cracking passwords, and discovering hidden vulnerabilities.

  • Solve Challenges: Each mission features quick puzzles and logic tasks that push your hacking skills.

  • Boost Your Arsenal: Unlock new tools to hack faster and smarter.

STORY

While carrying out what should have been a routine mission, something goes wrong. Suddenly, you're flagged by one of the world’s most powerful corporations, and now you're a target.

As the net tightens around you, survival becomes your only objective. You’ll need to rely on your skills, stay invisible, and navigate a world where every move is monitored, and every connection could be a trap.

  • Trust No One: Dive into a world of deception and lies, where nothing is as it seems.

  • Stay in the Shadows: Use your hacking skills to avoid detection, slip past surveillance, and escape the grip of a system that wants you erased.

name: Void Future: Hacking Protocol

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: x64 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes

short_description: In Void Future: Hacking Protocol, you play as a hacker in a cyberpunk world ruled by corporations. Hack, solve puzzles, and uncover a global conspiracy. Hunted by a system that never sleeps, you’ll need to stay hidden, outsmart surveillance, and fight to survive.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
